description: Price history and price check for a product sold in India, from CheapestInIndia's price tracking: current price, lowest and highest price ever (with dates), lowest in the last 7/30/90 days, how often the price changes, a price chart, and a factual verdict on where today's price sits. Use it for 'is ₹X a good price for <product>?', 'price history of <product>', 'lowest price of <product>', 'was it cheaper before?' and 'should I buy now or has it been lower?'. Pass the product name as `query` (e.g. 'JBL Flip 6') — the best-matching listing is used and other listings are returned so you can switch — or an exact `id` from another tool. Shown to the user as a price-history card with a chart. The verdict describes the past only — never present it as a forecast.

id.description: CheapestInIndia product id (from search_products, get_product or lookup_product_by_url)

query.description: Product name, brand + model if known, e.g. 'JBL Flip 6' or 'Samsung 55 inch Crystal 4K TV'

name: get_price_history

verdict.description: Factual position of the current price in its history

matchedQuery.description: The query used to pick this listing

otherListings.description: Other listings for the query (other stores, sizes or models) — pass one's id to switch

atLowestPrice.description: True when the current price is the lowest ever recorded

id.description: CheapestInIndia product id — pass through unchanged

lowestPrice.description: Lowest price ever recorded by CheapestInIndia, INR

mrp.description: Maximum retail price in INR, when known

priceChange.description: Most recent price change in INR (negative = price dropped, positive = went up)

productPageUrl.description: CheapestInIndia price-history page — use for citations

productUrl.description: Attributed buy link (CheapestInIndia redirect to the retailer)

title: Price history & price check
